method: Batch 47 (serverplayer): the batch 46 harness where the probe player is the server copy under the C03 rules: the client is a separate position (the walk and move ops drive it) that sends a position packet when it moved over 0.03 or 20 ticks passed (EntityClientPlayerMP.sendMotionUpdates), and the copy is put back to the position it had after each EntityPlayerMP.onUpdateEntity (NetHandlerPlayServer.processPlayer), so only its motion keeps what the update did (block collisions, water, lava, web, ladder, the sneak edge, flying). Row elements 6 and 7 are the client onGround flag (op ground) and y; element 8 is the copy position after the tick. Scenarios: knockbacks into a wall, a ceiling and a ledge, in the air, in water, lava, a web and on a ladder, creeper blasts in the open and against obsidian, slow and nudged clients, a herd and a flying creative player. Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
